fieldValues.title: Agents cannot tell which build they use
fieldValues.statement: Every build reports the same version, a mounted server keeps an old build until the session restarts, and stale sibling checkouts pass locally then fail in CI. The agent's picture of what the tools can do silently disagrees with the tools.
source_ref: srs-context:A mounted MCP server keeps the old srs binary until the session restarts
srs-context:Stale sibling checkouts give false greens
